test_title: PYST 11: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: What is the most appropriate connection to real-life situations?

options.text: Importance of winning a lottery to fulfil dreams
The negative impact of following one’s passion
Sell your belongings to fulfil your dreams

solution:
The correct answer is Option 1)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sheena's Efforts:** The passage primarily highlights Sheena's hard work, **as she works at a restaurant till midnight to save money for her education, demonstrating her dedication.**
 
• **Father's Sacrifice: Her** **father's decision to sell his ancestral property further emphasizes the value of hard work and sacrifice in achieving goals.**
 
• **Academic Success:** Sheena's achievement of securing a** 3rd all India ranking in the joint medical entrance test **underscores the notion that her hard work and determination led to her success.
 
• **Real-Life Relevance: **The story reflects the common** real-life scenario **where individuals work tirelessly and make sacrifices to achieve their dreams, showing that perseverance and hard work are crucial.
 
• **Inspirational Message: **The passage serves as an inspirational message to readers, reinforcing the idea that hard work and dedication can overcome financial and other obstacles.
 
• **Outcome: **The positive outcome of** Sheena **getting admission to a government medical college is a testament to the payoff of her hard work and efforts.

Therefore, the correct answer is** 'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **Importance of winning a lottery to fulfil dreams - This is incorrect as the passage does not mention anything about winning a lottery; it focuses on hard work and determination.
 
• **Option 3:** The negative impact of following one’s passion - This is incorrect because the passage demonstrates a positive impact, showing the success that comes from following one's passion.
 
• **Option 4:** Sell your belongings to fulfil your dreams - This is incorrect as it only reflects a part of the story (her father selling property) and does not capture the essence of hard work and overall determination.
